overall_policy.description: Cardiff publishes A100 Stage 1 entry requirements, UCAT requirement, resit policy, English language requirements and professional checks. Official evidence resolves GCSE scoring count as eight GCSEs and GCSE science minimums as Biology and Chemistry A/7 or Double Science AA/77; A-level subject wording remains represented with the published AS-level exception.
not_eligible_if: UCAT is not completed in the year of application.
Application is incomplete due to missing personal statement, academic reference or required qualification information.
Transfers/RPL onto A100 are not accepted.

grade_requirements.subject: Biology and Chemistry or Double Science
grade_requirements.exact_value: GCSE Double Science AA/77, or GCSE Biology A/7 and GCSE Chemistry A/7.

grade_requirements.subject: Other GCSEs
grade_requirements.exact_value: Eight GCSEs are scored for Cardiff A100 selection.

count_conflict.previous_conflict: Previous 8 versus 9 GCSE evidence conflict resolved by official/FOI-verified Cardiff update.
count_conflict.notes: Use 8 GCSEs for Cardiff A100 Stage 2 GCSE scoring. GCSE score maximum is 24.

resit_policy.policy: GCSE/Level 2 resits accepted only if completed within 12 months of the original sitting, except English Language, which has no time limit but must be achieved on the application.

gcse.notes: GCSE scoring count is officially resolved as eight GCSEs with maximum GCSE score 24. GCSE science minimum is officially GCSE Double Science AA/77, or GCSE Biology A/7 and GCSE Chemistry A/7.

a_level.third_subject_rules: Third subject must be an academic subject in Cardiff admissions information; Welsh Baccalaureate may be used as third A-level equivalent in that source.

conflicting_values.value: AAA must include Biology and Chemistry.
Core subject Biology or Chemistry, plus another science from Chemistry, Biology, Mathematics, Physics or Psychology, plus a third academic subject.

published_exception.value: Applicants offering Biology or Chemistry and a second science such as Physics or Maths may still be considered if they achieve grade A at AS Level in the Biology or Chemistry subject not offered at A2.

subject_conflict.notes: Do not flatten this into a single simple subject rule until the conflict is resolved.

resit_policy.policy: Level 3 resits are not normally accepted. They may only be considered for previous conditional offer holders with evidenced extenuating circumstances, reviewed before reapplication.

a_level.notes: A-level grades are official. Subject wording conflicts between official Cardiff sources; AS exception is official.

subject_substitution_rules: Grade 7 in SL Biology or Chemistry can replace HL Biology or Chemistry if the applicant also has grade 6 in HL Maths, Physics or Statistics.
ib.notes: 36 overall excluding Theory of Knowledge and the Extended Essay, including 18 at Higher Level.

scottish.notes: Specific Scottish Higher / Advanced Higher rules were not found in the checked official Cardiff A100 2026 sources.

baccalaureate_wales.value: Advanced Skills Baccalaureate Wales accepted in lieu of one A-level at the listed grades, excluding specified subjects.

btec.notes: Cardiff states BTECs are not accepted for this programme.

t_level.notes: Cardiff states T Levels are not accepted for this programme.

access_to_he.notes: Agored Cymru Access to Higher Education Diploma (Medicine) appears in the School policy in the context of widening participation / non-standard qualifications. Exact Stage 1 credit requirements are not fully extracted.

degree.a_level_requirement: BBB/ABC at A-level or equivalent, including subject requirements
degree.phd_applicant_requirement: Completed PhD applicants require BBC at A-level and must meet all other graduate criteria.
degree.notes: Graduate applicants must have completed the degree or be in the final year; degree results must be awarded and conferred by 31 August of entry year.

post_16.notes: Qualification acceptance represented only where checked official Cardiff sources publish a rule.

ucat.notes: UCAT is required in the year of application. No minimum UCAT threshold is published; UCAT may be used in selection and any cut-off varies by cycle.

sjt.notes: Official/FOI-verified Cardiff evidence confirms SJT is ignored: not used in scoring, not used as a gate/filter and not used as a tie-breaker.

ucat.minimum_score_policy: No minimum UCAT threshold is published. UCAT may be used as part of the selection process and any cut-off varies by cycle.

sjt.notes: Official/FOI-verified Cardiff evidence confirms SJT is ignored: not used in scoring, not used as a gate/filter and not used as a tie-breaker.

admissions_test.notes: UCAT is required. SJT is officially ignored for Cardiff A100: not scored, not gated/filtered and not used as a tie-breaker.

resits.policy: Level 2 resits accepted within 12 months except English Language; Level 3 resits not normally accepted except previous conditional offer holders with evidenced extenuating circumstances.
resits.conditions: See GCSE and A-level resit policies.

adjustments.notes: Where selection processes such as interview are in place, eligible contextual students may receive additional consideration rather than a simple lowered grade offer.

multiple_category_policy.value: If eligible in more than one listed additional-consideration category, applicant receives additional consideration in one category only.

contextual.notes: Guaranteed interview applies only for named widening participation initiatives where minimum entry requirements are met.

english_language.notes: Trinity ISE II is not accepted.

age_or_degree.minimum_age_policy: Must be 18 by 20 September of Year 1.
age_or_degree.notes: Degree requirements are represented under post_16.degree for graduate A100 applicants.

age_or_professional_checks.notes: Must be 18 by 20 September of Year 1. Professional checks apply before/at enrolment.

non_academic.notes: Personal statement must demonstrate awareness of the UK healthcare system and medical training. Missing personal statement or academic reference may cause rejection as incomplete.

international_selection.notes: This activates international ranking without changing eligibility rules or any component of the existing 28-point scoring system.

ranking_factors.notes: Official/FOI-verified formula uses GCSE Score (max 24) plus Further Education Point (max 1).
UCAT decile score contributes up to 3 points to the official 28-point pre-interview total.
Named WP programmes can guarantee interview if minimum entry requirements are met. Other contextual categories receive additional consideration.

score_components.notes: Eight GCSEs are scored. Grades 9/8/A* = 3, 7/A = 2, 6/B = 1. Maximum GCSE score is 24.
UCAT decile score maximum is 3 points.
Further Education Point maximum is 1. This is an official component of the 28-point pre-interview formula.

scoring_order.value: Mandatory subjects are scored first, then remaining highest graded subjects.

gcse_points.notes: Official/FOI-verified Cardiff update resolves scored GCSE count as eight. Maximum GCSE score is 24.

a_level_points.notes: A-level/further education achievement contributes through the separate Further Education Point in the official 28-point formula where applicable.

degree_points.value: If applying with a degree and minimum GCSE and A-level grades have been achieved, applicant is considered to have met the maximum academic threshold rather than Cardiff stating they will achieve 27.
degree_points.notes: Further/higher education achievement is represented through the Further Education Point, max 1.

additional_points.description: Further Education Point is an official component of Cardiff A100 pre-interview scoring with maximum 1 point.

total_score.formula: Total Score = GCSE Score + UCAT Decile Score + Further Education Point
total_score.notes: Official/FOI-verified Cardiff evidence confirms the 28-point pre-interview formula. Historical score bands must not be treated as official cut-offs.

calculation.notes: Official pre-interview formula is available: Total Score = GCSE Score + UCAT Decile Score + Further Education Point, max 28. Interview and offer scoring remain unpublished.

thresholds.notes: A UCAT cut-off may be applied if too many applicants have excellent academic scores. The cut-off is not predetermined and may differ between groups.

selection_adjustments.notes: Named WP programmes can guarantee interview if minimum requirements are met. Other contextual categories receive additional consideration.

tie_breakers.value: Raw UCAT score is used as the tie-breaker for applicants with the same total pre-interview score.
